cases.prompt: 继续维护这个别人留下的小程序之前，先盘点规则文件、未提交改动、真实入口和未知风险。
Before resuming this inherited mini app, inventory repository rules, uncommitted work, actual entry points, and unknown risks read-only.
这个需求只有一句话，请先明确用户、核心问题、版本一范围和各状态下的行为。
This request is one sentence; clarify users, core problem, version-one scope, flows, and behavior in every state.
已定稿的流程要落地，请给出页面、组件、服务、接口契约、失败策略和 ADR。
Map the finalized flow into pages, components, services, interface contracts, failure policy, and an ADR.
核对微信小程序 project 配置、编译产物目录、授权拒绝路径和平台申报是否属于同一证据层。
Classify WeChat project configuration, compiled output roots, permission refusal paths, and platform declarations by evidence layer.
按确认的接口契约修改现有小程序代码，保护当前改动并执行最小相关测试。
Modify the existing mini-program code to the confirmed interface contract while preserving current changes and running focused tests.
评估这个小程序页面在窄屏、横屏、刘海屏和键盘弹起时的布局与手势冲突。
Assess this mini-program interface for narrow screens, landscape, notches, keyboard overlap, scrolling, and gesture conflicts.
接口偶尔成功但页面仍显示失败，不要吞错误，先用判别实验确认是竞态、缓存还是构建版本。
The API sometimes succeeds while the page shows failure; use discriminating checks to distinguish races, cache, and build-version causes.
验证这个功能是否真的完成，固定源码与构建指纹，并列出 passed、failed、blocked 和 not-run。
Verify whether this feature is truly complete, bind evidence to source and build fingerprints, and report passed, failed, blocked, and not-run layers.
做一次只读发布预检，分清 push、build、upload、review、approval 和 production 的当前状态。
Run a read-only release preflight and distinguish push, build, upload, review, approval, production, and rollback evidence.
There is no reproducible defect yet; first establish what this inherited repository contains and how it is built.
用户离线后是否保留进度还没决定，先把这个产品规则定清楚，不要直接选数据库。
Do not write code yet; compare two state-management designs and document migration and rollback tradeoffs.
只判断微信隐私接口、配置声明和平台申报是否一致，不判断整个版本能不能发布。
The cause of the regression is unknown, so reproduce and isolate it before running broad acceptance checks.
测试报告已有了，现在只核对版本号、正式构建、回滚材料和上传授权。
Draft a polite follow-up email after a sales meeting.
提醒我周五下午交水电费。
Extract the tables from this annual-report PDF.
给我一个番茄炖牛腩的食谱。
Compare the screen with the approved reference across devices, then independently verify the implemented behavior and evidence layers.
先定位登录后状态回退的根因，再在证据成立后做最小修复和回归测试。
Read-only intake this unfamiliar repository and then report whether its existing artifacts are release-ready without uploading anything.
设计权限与失败策略，同时核对这些能力在微信平台的配置、隐私声明和证据层。
